bagPolicy.summary: Iveagh Gardens concert rules are issued by the event promoter and may change between concert series. Check the official event page and ticket-holder email before arrival.
bagPolicy.note: The park's everyday visitor rules are not a substitute for concert security requirements.

parking.note: The venue is in central Dublin and the promoter does not provide event parking. Public transport is recommended; use current event travel information when planning your route.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Iveagh Gardens's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Food and beverage arrangements are temporary and event-specific. Review the official event information and on-site signage for the current concert series.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Iveagh Gardens, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Iveagh Gardens's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Iveagh Gardens. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Iveagh Gardens. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
